key_insight: This manuscript was withdrawn because the dataset had too few positive endometrial cancer cases, making the reported TyGFI risk findings unreliable.
clinical_relevance: It should not be used to support screening, prediction, or clinical decision-making for endometrial cancer risk in U.S. women aged 45 and older.
method: NHANES 2011-2018 observational analysis in U.S. women aged >=45
Integrated data engineering, machine learning, and logistic modeling
Evaluated the combined triglyceride-glucose and frailty index (TyGFI)
evidence_signal: The abstract states that the number of positive cases was too small, creating major statistical flaws and invalid conclusions.
watch_item: Because the study was withdrawn for insufficient positive-case count, any apparent model performance or associations should be considered unreliable and not cited.
paper_title: WITHDRAWN: Combined triglyceride-glucose and frailty index (TyGFI) and risk of endometrial cancer in U.S. women aged >=45: NHANES 2011-2018 analysis integrating data engineering and machine learning with logistic modeling
